description: Atlantis begins the season stranded in space and soon faces renewed Asuran and Wraith conflicts under Carter's command, while Michael's experiments and Teyla's missing people become increasingly central.

s04e01.description: Atlantis drifts through space with failing power after escaping the Asuran weapon, while Weir's injuries force McKay to consider a dangerous nanite treatment.

s04e02.description: Sheppard's team infiltrates the Asuran homeworld to steal a ZPM and alter the Replicators' programming before Atlantis runs out of life support.

s04e03.description: Ronon reunites with surviving Satedan comrades and considers leaving Atlantis, but their new loyalties prove far less simple than he hoped.

s04e04.description: A crystalline entity copied from Sheppard invades the crew's dreams and turns their deepest fears into lethal nightmares.

s04e05.description: A nomadic human crew abducts Sheppard to activate Ancient technology aboard their ship and draw him into their war with the Wraith.

s04e06.description: A rapidly spreading pathogen erases memories throughout Atlantis, leaving the remaining unaffected crew to restore order before everyone forgets who they are.

s04e07.description: Teyla and Keller visit an Athosian settlement and find it abandoned, then become hunted by ruthless scavengers while searching for survivors.

s04e08.description: An elderly seer shows Carter disturbing visions of Atlantis's future as Wraith and Replicator activity begins converging around the city.

s04e09.description: Jeannie Miller is kidnapped by a businessman desperate to use McKay's nanotechnology research to save his dying daughter.

s04e10.description: The team encounters duplicates of themselves created by Replicators and learns that the Asurans have changed strategy in their war against the Wraith.

s04e11.description: Atlantis unites Wraith and human forces for a massive assault on the Asuran fleet, using McKay's plan to turn the Replicators' own nature against them.

s04e12.description: The team discovers a Wraith cloning facility and learns how a single queen once used Ancient technology to create enormous armies.

s04e13.description: An automated quarantine locks Atlantis into sealed compartments, trapping crew members in increasingly dangerous situations across the city.

s04e14.description: Sheppard and McKay escort a young princess through dangerous territory so she can complete the rite required to inherit her kingdom.

s04e15.description: Sheppard returns to Earth after his father's death and becomes involved in the hunt for a human-form Replicator created by a rogue research project.

s04e16.description: Carter, McKay and Keller fall into a collapsing underground chamber and must improvise an escape while injuries and structural failure close off every route.

s04e17.description: Teal'c visits Atlantis to prepare Ronon for an IOA interview, only for both warriors to become trapped in a Wraith takeover of the Midway station.

s04e18.description: A mysterious disease spreads across Pegasus while evidence points to Michael, and Teyla learns her missing people may still be alive.

s04e19.description: The expedition discovers that Michael has revived a cloned Beckett and is using both Athosians and Wraith in experiments to create his hybrid species.

s04e20.description: Sheppard returns to an abandoned Atlantis tens of thousands of years in the future, where a holographic McKay explains the disastrous timeline that followed his disappearance.
